en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked himasws about the overturning by the Prophetsaww of hissaww cloak when hesaww (prayed the Salāt for the) rain. So heasws said: ‘A sign between himsaww and hissaww companions of the overturning of the aridity (dryness) into fertility’ (growth).
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya in a marfu‘ manner has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about how the Holy prophet turned his gown upside down when pleading before Allah for rain.
He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘It is a sign between him and his companions that turns aridity to fertility.’”
